Chapter I · Before our paths crossed

Two little worlds.
One beautiful story.

Long before we knew each other's names, we were two little people growing up in two different worlds. These are our beginnings—not together yet, just two separate stories waiting to become something new.

✦ ❀ ✦

Not a clue what life was planning.

Little Shunuu

Then, one little reel

Chapter VIII · Please read this slowly

A letter from your COAT.

Here is the part that doesn't need a special effect. Just words, from me to you.

To my Shunuu,

Happy birthday, my Shunuu.

Sometimes I think about how our story started with something as simple as a calisthenics reel. I saw you, you caught my attention, and I chose to tell you how I felt. I couldn't have known then all the little memories that would follow—the conversations, your singing voice notes, the jokes, the affectionate chaos, and the way your presence became part of my days.

I want you to know that I admire so many things about you. I admire the girl who keeps practising, who wants to improve, who takes on new skills, who shows up for her goals. I admire your strength and your discipline. I also adore the girl who loves flowers, who can be romantic and mischievous, who makes me smile, and who has a whole collection of little sides that make you unmistakably you.

I hope this new year of your life brings you more reasons to feel proud of yourself. I hope your hard work opens doors for you. I hope you keep finding songs that make you sing, flowers that make you pause, dreams that make you excited, and people who remind you that you deserve care even on the days when you're tired.

You don't have to be strong every second. You don't have to achieve something every day to be worthy of love. You don't have to look perfect in every picture or have the right words for every feeling. You can have quiet days, silly days, confused days, and days when all you do is rest. I hope you give yourself the patience you so often give your goals.

Thank you for the memories we've already made, and for letting me be part of your story. This website is full of photos and effects, but none of them can fully explain what you mean to me. I made it because I wanted you to have something you could open and discover little pieces of yourself inside it—your strength, your smile, your songs, your flowers, and the moments that remind me why I'm glad our paths crossed.

For the future, I hope we keep choosing honesty, patience, care, laughter, and the courage to talk things through. I hope we keep learning each other, supporting each other's dreams, and making room for both the serious parts and the ridiculous parts of life. I can't promise that every day will be easy, but I can promise that the future I hope for is one where we keep treating each other with kindness and intention.

Today, I want you to feel celebrated. Not because you have to be impressive. Not because you have to be cheerful. Just because it's your birthday, because you're here, and because the person you are means a great deal to me.

Keep growing, keep singing, keep being strong, keep being soft, keep being your funny little pagal self. And whenever life gets loud, I hope you remember that you are loved for much more than what you can do.

Happy birthday, Shunuu. May this year bring you beautiful surprises, brave new beginnings, peaceful nights, flowers you love, and countless little reasons to smile.

Always cheering for you,
your COAT ♡

Some gifts are beautiful.
Some carry a meaning.

The butterfly pendant has its own memory. This ring is a separate symbol of the commitment and future I hope to keep building with you.

For the future we're still writing.

This ring is my little symbol of commitment. Not a demand to have everything figured out today, but a reminder of the future I hope for: one where we keep choosing honesty, patience, respect, and each other as we grow.

“I want to keep building something real with you—one thoughtful day, one honest conversation, one promise kept at a time.”

Whatever comes next, I hope we never stop cheering for the person each of us is becoming.
